settings.routing.strategy.label: Routing strategy
settings.routing.strategy.description: Picks the account for each new request.
settings.routing.strategy.guide.capacity: Default. Weighted random pick by remaining headroom × capacity × weight, so accounts with more room left get more traffic.
settings.routing.strategy.guide.relative: Remaining credits divided by time until reset — favours accounts whose quota would otherwise expire unused.
settings.routing.strategy.guide.usageWei: Sends traffic to the account with the lowest observed 7-day, then 5-hour usage.
settings.routing.strategy.guide.roundRob: Cycles through eligible accounts evenly, ignoring quota.
settings.routing.strategy.guide.fillFirs: Uses the highest-priority account until it is nearly full, then moves to the next.
settings.routing.strategy.guide.sequenti: Drains accounts in a fixed order (lowest priority number first) until each is nearly out of headroom.
settings.routing.strategy.guide.resetDra: Uses the account whose quota window resets soonest first, so capacity about to reset is not wasted.
settings.routing.strategy.guide.singleAc: Sends everything to the highest-priority available account. Sticky sessions are ignored.
